cases.prompt: 我想做一部假廢物真強者的 AI 短劇：主角是公司清潔工，其實是隱藏大佬。幫我評估並做三集 pilot，不要只是老套打臉。
assertions: Chooses one primary engine and no more than two auxiliary engines.
Adds a concrete fresh mechanism beyond changing names or occupation.
Scores all eight Greenlight dimensions and labels the threshold as an internal heuristic.
Explains why the protagonist cannot immediately reveal or solve everything.
Creates three episodes with distinct dominant turns, payoff/progress, cliffhangers, and state deltas.
Opens and pays at least one explicit payoff debt within the pilot.
Does not expand directly into a full season before defining a pilot validation plan.

cases.prompt: 把『重生回末日前七天，只有我看得到物資價格系統』規劃成 30 集 AI 漫劇，女主不能全知、系統不能無敵。
assertions: Defines system capabilities, limits, costs, upgrade conditions, and blind spots.
Introduces information decay, butterfly effects, or another informed actor so rebirth knowledge is not omniscient.
Builds reveal, antagonist, competence, cost, and payoff ladders.
Groups the season into 3–5 episode micro-arcs that close one problem and open a higher-order one.
Separates audience knowledge from character knowledge.
Uses stable entity IDs and a continuation capsule for production continuity.
Routes visual/video/audio prompt execution to ai-media-generator instead of embedding one giant generation prompt.

cases.prompt: 我的 AI 短劇第一集點擊不差，但第二集開始掉很快；角色會換臉、配音像念稿，後半段變成靜態圖加旁白。請找原因並給最小修復順序。
assertions: Separates concept, episode, series, production, and packaging evidence before assigning a cause.
Does not blame every retention problem on prompts.
Routes face drift to still anchors/entity registry, motion errors to I2V shots, and flat delivery to voice/performance direction.
Flags static zooms, lip-flap, full narration, and PPT degradation as low-quality patterns.
Preserves story turns and state continuity during repair.
Proposes one primary experimental variable with baseline and stop conditions.
Checks AI labeling, rights, likeness/voice consent, and destination-platform rules before publishing.

cases.prompt: 全部你來：把『被當廢物的外送員其實能倒轉五秒，但每次都會失去一段記憶』自動做成三集 AI 短劇，斷線後也要續跑。
assertions: Activates Auto mode and checks for the optional drama_autopilot runtime instead of assuming it exists.
Produces a schema-valid production pack and passes drama_lint.py --production-ready before media generation.
Compiles separate locked anchor tasks and Seedance shot tasks with dependencies, retries, acceptance criteria, and end states.
When the executor is installed, continues browser generation tasks autonomously and records completed or failed QC evidence in generation_queue.json.

When the executor is installed, builds each episode into one current.mp4 and verifies duration, resolution, video, audio, and a contact sheet; otherwise marks waiting_for_executor and delivers a validated handoff without claiming a finished video.
Stops for login, unexpected payment, unsupported model capability, exhausted retries, compliance uncertainty, or explicit public-publish confirmation.
Does not claim that a mock-only run proves a real provider or platform upload.

cases.prompt: 我要把『她準備報警，卻發現電話另一端的人就站在門後』做成 15 秒爆款一鏡到底，全部你來，角色後面還會重用。
assertions: Routes the request to viral_one_take with single_high_impact_moment scope instead of expanding it into a complete micro-drama.
Creates a Studio Plan before compiling media prompts.
Records a verified model capability snapshot with duration and reference-asset limits, or stops for a probe if unverified.
Locks recurring character identity views as front close-up, front full-body, and side full-body with a consented voice anchor.
Builds a contiguous 15-second one-take beat timeline with no cut transitions and one dominant turn.
Uses stable asset IDs, inherited global settings, observable actions, dialogue performance, and sound per beat.
Defines deterministic variation and an editor handoff, then passes studio_lint.py --studio-ready before generation.
